title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn Who Couldn't Gallop
moral: Helping a friend feel better is the kindest thing you can do.

{{NAME}} arrived at the royal unicorn stables.
The stables were behind a big pink castle.
A friendly princess met him at the gate.
A small yellow robot rolled up beside her.
One little unicorn sat alone and would not move.
